about: What the page's workers load into Pyodide (web/python-boot.js): the release; the folder of it on the CDN, where pyc is the release with its Python compiled to bytecode already; the Python that release runs, which the build compiles the app's own Python for; the packages loaded from the release at the start (packaging among them, which patsy imports and the release does not list as its dependency); the packages of the release a model is fitted with, which the designed-experiments page loads once it is ready, or when a call first needs them; and the PyPI packages micropip installs, each pinned. The workers, the wasm tests, the build and CI all read this file.
